cmd: cd /app && mkdir -p ssl && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -keyout ssl/server.key -out ssl/server.crt -days 365 -nodes -subj "/O=DevOps Team/CN=dev-internal.company.local" && chmod 600 ssl/server.key && cat ssl/server.key ssl/server.crt > ssl/server.pem && ls -l ssl/

cd /app && { echo "Subject: $(openssl x509 -in ssl/server.crt -noout -subject)"; echo "Valid dates:"; openssl x509 -in ssl/server.crt -noout -dates; echo "SHA-256 Fingerprint: $(openssl x509 -in ssl/server.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256)"; } > ssl/verification.txt && cat ssl/verification.txt
python3 -c "import ssl; print(ssl.OPENSSL_VERSION)"; python3 -c "import cryptography; print(cryptography.__version__)" 2>&1 | tail -1

cd /app && ls -l ssl/ check_cert.py && echo "--- key perms: $(stat -c %a ssl/server.key)" && openssl x509 -in ssl/server.crt -noout -subject -dates && openssl rsa -in ssl/server.key -noout -text 2>/dev/null | head -1 && echo "--- pem check:" && grep -c "BEGIN" ssl/server.pem && openssl x509 -in ssl/server.pem -noout -subject && openssl pkey -in <(awk '/BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY/,/END RSA PRIVATE KEY/' ssl/server.pem) -noout && echo "pem key OK" && cat ssl/verification.txt
grep "BEGIN" /app/ssl/server.pem && awk '/BEGIN PRIVATE KEY/,/END PRIVATE KEY/' /app/ssl/server.pem | openssl pkey -in /dev/stdin -noout && echo "PEM key OK" && cat /app/ssl/verification.txt
